info.name: Account Panel - The Steel
info.description: All Account Panel APIs for The Steel / Mr-Storage Backend

exec:
const r = pm.response.json();
if (r.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('token', r.data.accessToken);

item.name: Get Financial Stats
item._postman_note: Returns: totalRevenue, totalExpenses, netProfit, outstanding

item.name: Get Invoice Stats
item._postman_note: Returns: total, paid, unpaid, overdue, totalSales

item.name: Get Payment Distribution
item._postman_note: Returns: paid/pending/overdue counts, amounts, percentages

item.name: Get Cost Breakdown (Material/Labour/Logistics)
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: breakdown{material, labour, logistics, other}, total

item.name: Get WIP Projects (Profit Analysis)
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: projects[] with revenue, totalCost, netProfit, profitMargin per project

item.name: Payment Overview (Deposit/Progress/Final)
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: summary{totalOrderValue/totalReceived/outstanding}, depositPayments{%/total/received/pending}, progressPayments, finalPayments, clientBreakdown[], invoices[]

item.name: Orders & Payments Summary
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: summary{totalOrderValue/totalReceived/outstanding/totalWipProfit}, orders[] with paymentBreakdown{deposit/progress/final}

item.name: WIP Profit Dashboard
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: summary{totalProjectValue/totalCostToDate/currentWipProfit/profitMargin}, mostProfitable[], decreasingMargin[], projects[] with costBreakdown

item.name: Project Cost Analysis Table
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: rows[] with project/category/estimated/actual/variance/date

item.name: Order Value vs Plant Costs
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: totalOrderValue, totalPlantCosts, projectedProfit

query.description: materials | labour | equipment | transport | utilities | permits | subcontractor | office | maintenance | other

item.name: Profit & Loss Report
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: rows[] with orderId/projectName/revenue/expense/netProfit/margin/status, summary{totalRevenue/totalExpense/netProfit/avgMargin}, expenseByCategory, monthlyTrend[]

item.name: Cash Flow Report
item._postman_note: NEW — Returns: points[] with label/inflow/outflow/net per month (12 months), summary{totalInflow/totalOutflow/netCashFlow}

item.name: Get Tax Stats
item._postman_note: Returns: totalPayable, totalPaid, pendingCount, overdueCount, paidCount, pendingFilings

item.name: Add New Tax
item._postman_note: UPDATED — now accepts filingFrequency (monthly|quarterly|annually|varies|local_only) and threshold fields

item.name: Get Delivery Finance (dashboard card)
item._postman_note: Returns: freightSpend, pendingCarrierPayments, freightSavings

item.name: Get Freight Costs Overview
item._postman_note: Returns: totalFreightCost, activeCarriers, avgCostPerDelivery, pendingInvoices, monthlyFreightCostTrend[], costDistributionByCarrier[], carrierCostAnalysis[], recentFreightCosts[]

item.name: Get Logistics Costs
item._postman_note: Returns: totalLogisticsCost, totalSavings, pendingInvoices, disputedItems, freightAndDeliveryCosts[] (carrier + delivery_company PaymentApproval records)

item.name: Get Cost Variance Analysis
item._postman_note: Returns: stats{netVariance, overBudget, underBudget, onBudget}, highVarianceAlerts[], awardedVsActualTrend[], varianceDetails[]

item.name: Get Awarded Freight Loads
item._postman_note: Sourced from FreightBid where status='selected'. Returns: stats{totalAwarded, totalLoads, activeLoads, totalSavings}, loads[] { project, carrier, schedule, bidDetails{originalBidAmount, awardedAmount, savings} }

item.name: Get Project Financial Summary (list projects)
item._postman_note: No leadId query param -> returns { projects[] } for the Select Project dropdown

item.name: Get Project Financial Summary (by project)
item._postman_note: Returns: summary{totalFreightCost, totalVendorCost, totalDeliveryCost, totalLogisticsCost, savingsFromBidding, costOverrun}, costDistributionByType[], costTrendOverTime[], costBreakdown[], monthlyCostComparison[]

item.name: Get Payment Approvals Queue
item._postman_note: Returns: stats{pendingApproval, underReview, approved, disputed}, approvals[] { invoiceType, companyName, invoiceNumber, project, amount, dueDate, linkedType, status }

item.name: Review Payment Approval (approve/reject/dispute)
item._postman_note: action: under_review | approved | disputed | rejected

item.name: Get Payment Status Dashboard
item._postman_note: Returns: stats{totalOutstanding, totalPaid, vendorPayments, carrierPayments}, overduePayments[], dueSoon[], paymentHistory[]

item.name: Get Vendor Invoices
item._postman_note: Returns: stats{totalPayable, pendingAmount, paidAmount}, invoices[]

item.name: Get Analytics Reporting
item._postman_note: Returns: stats{totalFreightSavings, avgSavingsPct, projectFreightCosts, deliverySpend, totalDeliveries}, freightSavingsReport[], projectFreightCostSummary[], monthlyCostTrendAnalysis[]

item.name: Get Channels (departments + direct)
item._postman_note: Returns: departments[] { channelId (role key), name, unread, lastMessage }, direct[] { channelId (userId), name, role, unread, lastMessage }. Real-time via Socket.io /admin namespace: events join_team_channel, team_message, new_team_message, team_typing_start/stop.

item.name: Get Channel Messages
item._postman_note: channelType: department (channelId = role key: admin|sales|construction|plant|account) | direct (channelId = other user's _id)

item.name: Send Channel Message (REST fallback)
item._postman_note: Primary send path is the socket event 'team_message'; this REST endpoint is a fallback that also broadcasts to the socket room.
